text:
Ava: Need a concise launch card + 1-pager for next week's webinar. Audience: platform/security buyers. Focus: deploy-mode decision flow, SLA bullets, short benchmark callouts, and an easy routing rule for inbound leads. Aim for print-friendly single column. Draft ready by Wed midday.
Sam: Proposed sections: TL;DR (1 line), Quick decision flow, 3 benchmark vignettes, Security & SLA highlights, Field play (questions + routing), CTA (download + PoC). Keep language action-oriented.
Jordan: I can produce a single-column Figma template. Suggest we include a mini decision tree graphic (hosted -> start free; dedicated -> commit; private -> contact sales). Will mock by Tue EOD.
Priya: Security copy: list supported KMS providers, HSM options, customer-managed keys, VPC peering, private link, audit logs retention policy (30/90/365d options), and certified controls (SOC2 Type II, ISO27001). Also add a short line on data residency options.
Miguel: For field: include a "2-min discovery" checklist: 1) expected peak qps, 2) data classification (P0 confidential?), 3) latency target (p50/p95), 4) regulatory constraints. Routing rule: if data_classification == 'regulated' OR wants_onprem == true -> route enterprise.
Sam: Benchmark vignettes (pick conservative internal numbers, mark as simulations):
- Chat (interactive): 4k context, p50 gen 120ms, p95 260ms, cost per 1k tokens $0.45, quantized variant -22% cost.
- Vector search (embeddings at scale): 2M/day, batch throughput 80k/min, unit cost $0.0009/embed, caching saves ~40% on repeated queries.
- Batch extraction (NLP pipelines): 300 concurrent jobs, dedicated pool keeps tail latency within SLO and reduces error rate vs shared by 3x.
Label: "Representative internal simulations; results vary by model and workload."
Priya: Add graceful-degradation note: automatic fallback to compatible variant + regional failover + transparent notification to customer via console + retry logic. Buyers like explicit failure modes.
Ava: Good. For routing, let's include a compact YAML snippet for engineers and one-liner for sales. Engineers will copy/paste.
Ava: routing snippet:
```
route_rules:
  - when: "lead.data_classification == 'regulated' or lead.wants_onprem == true"
    action: "route_to: enterprise-sdr"
  - when: "lead.expected_qps >= 1000 and lead.project_stage == 'pilot'"
    action: "route_to: solutions-eng"
  - when: "lead.budget >= 50000 and lead.urgency == 'ASAP'"
    action: "route_to: account-exec"
  - default: "route_to: growth-sdr"
```
Miguel: For the webinar CTA form: fields = company, role, primary_use_case (chat/embed/batch), timeframe (ASAP/1-3mo/6mo+), checkbox: regulatory review? If yes -> add note to payload: enterprise=true. We'll hook to webhook: https://hooks.redwood.test/lead
Jordan: Design note: use neutral slate background, single accent (warm orange) for CTAs. Make benchmark numbers callouts small badges. Use expandable details for SLA/controls.
Sam: 'What success looks like' — propose: "<200ms p50 for interactive chat at 4k context" OR ">30% unit cost savings on embedding-heavy workloads with caching+quantization". Pick whichever we can substantiate.
Priya: I'll write the security bullets + audit log retention options. Also will add an integrations line for common enterprise IAM providers.
Miguel: I'll create two sample lead payloads for the webhook test channel: regulated/onprem example and a pilot/growth example. Will include expected_qps and sample comments.
Ava: Owners: Jordan (design) Tue EOD, Priya (security + compliance copy) Tue EOD, Sam (bench vignettes + slide snippet) Tue EOD, Miguel (webhook samples) Tue EOD. I'll assemble final PDF and push to Drive Wed midday.
ops-bot: deploy-preview: one-pager PDF uploaded to https://drive.redwood/workspace/preview.pdf (preview link, internal only).
Ava: Perfect. Keep copy short. We'll do a quick review Wed 10am. Thanks all :rocket:
